thread:
Alice Chen: heads-up — we started seeing p95/p99 latency regressions on /v1/generate around 03:40 UTC after the runtime patch that adjusted kernel selection heuristics. Visible in hosted-prod-us-east1 and one Dedicated customer. Customers reported tail latency spikes up to ~1.8x for long prompts.
Diego Rivera: ack. which commit rolled? I think the flash_attn/SDPA gating change landed in c3f9a8d.
Alice Chen: yep c3f9a8d — the change tweaks prefer_flash_attention if sequence_length > 1024 and batch_size < 4.
Priya Nair: initial telemetry: p99 spikes correlate with sequence lengths ~1200-1600 and with token-by-token streaming. CPU side shows more kernel fallbacks and increased kernel launch times.
Jordan Patel: I grabbed flamegraphs from runtime trace. Looks like several fast kernels got slower due to additional checks in kernel_selector.cpp — especially the extra path for cuBLAS split-MHA. Attaching short snippet.
Jordan Patel: ```
# simplified repro of selector logic
if (supports_flash && seq_len <= flash_max && batch <= flash_batch)
  choose(flash_kernel)
else if (supports_sdpa && use_sdpa)
  choose(sdpa_kernel)
else
  choose(default_sdpa_fallback)
```
Samir Khan: interesting — customer reported no model accuracy regressions, just latency. Could be kernel micropath changed to use unrolled SDPA in more cases.
Alice Chen: quick mitigation: can we push a runtime hotfix to revert the heuristic and expose a runtime toggle so we can force SDPA/Flash per-model? We should also add env flag for compile flags.
Diego Rivera: I can build a hotfix branch that forces prefer_flash=false by default and adds REDWOOD_RUNTIME_FORCE_KERNEL=flash|sdpa|auto. Will run canary on 5 nodes.
Priya Nair: to help triage, here's a minimal reproducer customers can run against hosted API to trigger the path: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"open-llama-large","input":"'$(python -c "print('x'*1400)")'","max_tokens":16,"stream":true}'
```
Jordan Patel: also adding a perf-run script for local repro w/ different batch sizes: 
```
# run_local_repro.sh
for b in 1 2 4; do 
  ./run_infer --model open-llama-large --seq 1400 --batch $b --warmup 5 --iter 50 
done
```
Samir Khan: logs from customer show kernel name "cutlass_mha_fused_v2" switching to "sdpa_unrolled_v1" at runtime on those requests. Need to check if the compilers (nvcc flags) or cutlass version drifted during last release.
Alice Chen: note: deploy-bot reported build image bump to cutlass 2.4.1 in the same release. Could be ABI change that made flash kernel less favorable.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1379 — p99 spikes on /v1/generate, priority=high.
infra-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: rollback toggle prepared.
Diego Rivera: plan — 1) fast revert of heuristic (hotfix branch, canary 5 nodes) 2) add REDWOOD_RUNTIME_FORCE_KERNEL env + API model-level override 3) add telemetry counters for kernel switches and kernel_launch_ms 4) run binary comparison tests with cutlass 2.4.1 vs 2.3.x 5) postmortem and test targeting long-seq workloads
Priya Nair: I'll run perf matrix overnight to map (seq_len x batch x model) for flash vs sdpa and attach heatmap. Also will add alerting for sudden jump in kernel_launch_ms and consecutive SDPA fallback ratio > 10%.
Jordan Patel: for immediate customer relief, Diego can you flip canary to force sdpa for that customer's tenant? That should reduce tail latency even if median slightly increases.
Diego Rivera: can do. Pushing canary now and flipping REDWOOD_RUNTIME_FORCE_KERNEL=sdpa for tenant-id=acct_0x9a.
Alice Chen: excellent. After canary looks good, we'll roll to region. Keep me posted with p95/p99 numbers.
Samir Khan: FYI — we should also add a smoke test in CI that runs a few long-seq generation traces against every kernel combo to catch regressions early.
Alice Chen: agreed. I'll create a ticket and attach the reproducer and perf artifacts. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Diego Rivera: canary healthy after forcing sdpa — p99 down from 520ms to ~290ms for the long prompts. Rolling to region in 15m.
Alice Chen: update in 20m please, and let's prepare a customer-facing note for CS with workaround (tenant-level kernel override).
Priya Nair: collecting graphs now, will drop into the incident thread.
Samir Khan: follow-up: we might later re-enable flash once we fix kernel_selector scoring and test against cutlass 2.4.1. For now, fallback is the right call. :white_check_mark:
